g.text: Complete Interactive State Machine, Board Paths, Dice Probability & Google Sheets Data Pipeline
✓ If Found: Resumes { pos, rolls, contentIds }
4. CORE GAME TURN LOOP (Click Die to Roll)
• Rocket token hops square by square
• Player completes finale challenge (e.g., Mystery Object or Group Photo)
• Submits result: 'WINNER' ➔ Sheets marks status: 'WINNER 🏆' in bold green
• clearProgress(name) clears localStorage so next session is a clean replay
2. ALL 15 SQUARES & EVERY POSSIBLE BRANCHING PATH
COMPLETE STEP-BY-STEP TRANSITION MATRIX (DICE ROLLS: +1 or +2)
Warmup fires upon start, submits Sq 1 answer.
Ladder 1 bypasses square 5; task triggers on Sq 7.
Snake Challenge: Pass = stays on 8 | Fail = slides to 4.
If player slides to 4, they immediately do Sq 4 task.
Ladder 2 bypasses square 10; task triggers on Sq 12.
Snake Challenge: Pass = stays on 14 | Fail = slides to 6.
Reaching or overshooting 15 completes the game.
Either roll (1 or 2) reaches the Finale square!
3. DATA PIPELINE & GOOGLE APPS SCRIPT ENGINE
Matches normalized name or appends row
• Maps square number to target column
PHOTO UPLOAD & ISOLATED ERROR HANDLING ARCHITECTURE
Extracts MIME (image/jpeg) and decodes base64 buffer
Auto-finds or creates folder: "Snakes and Ladders Photos"
Appends clickable "Sq${sq}" link into Column 17 (Photos cell)
Multiple photo tasks accumulate cleanly in the SAME cell!
Never Fails Silently / Never Crashes Submission:
Top-level try/catch wraps doPost() so network never hangs.
If any error happens, it appends a row to 'Errors' sheet:
No need to inspect Apps Script execution logs.
If Drive quota or auth fails, writes error badge directly into cell:
Zero live volunteer intervention required during conference.
4. GOOGLE SHEETS LIVE SPREADSHEET SCHEMA & COLUMNS
• Frozen Columns: Col A (Name) and Row 1 (Headers) are permanently frozen for comfortable scanning.
• Conditional Formatting: Green (#C6F0D5) for WINNER 🏆, Purple (#F4F0FF) for In progress.
• Auto-Banding: Alternating zebra striping pre-formatted across 300 rows.
• Drive Links: Column 17 stores rich-text hyperlinks directly linking to photos stored in Google Drive.
• Errors Sheet: Separate 'Errors' tab tracks any exceptions with exact timestamp and stack trace.
FIGMA DESIGN SYSTEM SPECS & COMPONENT ARCHITECTURE
